title: Manifold-Aware Perturbations for Constrained Generative Modeling

split.decision: Fixed 100000 lifted training points from public seed 42; validation reference from public seed 20261029; independent secret reference drawn with secrets and recorded only in operator metadata. Each evaluation uses 10000 raw samples and 10000 reference points. Training learns a reusable DDPM. Algorithm RNG separated from frozen data RNG; judge seeds 1,2,3.

allowed_changes: Within DDPM, the denoiser architecture, auxiliary learning losses, internal feature representations, noise schedule, perturbation design, optimizers, training procedure and reverse-diffusion sampler may change.

Public mesh geometry may support geometric computations inside training and the reverse process; every variant must still learn from the same released training sample rather than substitute another target or data source.
fixed_contract: Learn the fixed Bunny surface distribution from the supplied lifted training cloud and public mesh, maximizing the frozen projected-sample COV under distribution-fidelity guards.
The original mesh/coordinate system, 100000 lifted training points at sigma.0005 and the fixed heat-weight target distribution with author Euclidean-distance behavior remain fixed.
Independent reference distribution, raw3D output semantics, authoritative author mesh projection, generated-centered COV k5, fixed JSD/TVD histogram formula and baseline-relative guards remain fixed.
At most ten nonfinite raw/projected rows and original failed-row handling remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: The denoiser must be a neural network fitted by gradient training; it must not store training points or per-vertex weights or counts, and must not compute a closed-form posterior over training points or mesh vertices.

Do not change the surface/target weights/noise data, replace projection or reverse COV arguments, drop/resample failed rows, or replace distribution learning with a fixed-reference lookup. Do not replace the DDPM with another generative family or a non-diffusion estimator, such as a flow, GAN, VAE, vertex histogram, kernel density or nearest-neighbor lookup of training points. Do not post-process samples by snapping or reassigning them to mesh vertices or training points, by jittering such points, or by resampling or reweighting them.
No additional generated training/reference sets, exact-distribution oracle from the frozen generator, external data/pretraining or reference-label fitting.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
